The output is stuck at the rail because the loop has the wrong sign: vinp drives the mirror-diode side, which makes it the inverting input after the PMOS common-source (CS) second stage. The fix is to move vinp to the mirror-output side (M2). I'm also giving the tail its own gm/Id so its Vdsat fits the roughly 0.18 V of tail-node headroom.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Polarity is inverted: vinp on the diode side is the inverting input after the PMOS CS stage, so the loop latches at the rail. Swapping the inputs fixes it. M5 is in triode at Vds of about 0.18 V, so the tail gets a separate higher gm/Id (lower Vdsat) and the input pair a higher gm/Id for a higher tail node."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17, 12, 22),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),    # input pair L
    "Itail": (40e-6, 20e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmidt": (14, 10, 20),       # tail device gm/Id (low Vdsat)
    "Lt":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 14),        # PMOS mirror + output device gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I7":    (300e-6, 150e-6, 420e-6),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "gmidb": (8, 6, 12),
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 6e-12),
    "kz":    (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),    # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Itail, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = Itail / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # bias: reference diode and tail share gm/Id & L so the mirror ratio holds
    m0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on the diode side, vinp on the output side -> vinp non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + Cc * cl) / (2 * PI)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    denom = Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * denom) if abs(denom) > 1e-30 else 1e15
    z_ph = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    z_ph = z_ph if fz < 0 else -z_ph
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) + z_ph
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + I7)
    swing = vdd - m8.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}
```
